verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms that a live llms.txt at developer.paddle.com returns HTTP 200, and the pack shows sectioned llms files (migrate, changelog, sdks) and .md page variants. Paddle also documents agent-specific docs: skills "written specifically for agents" at a well-known index URL, a docs MCP server, and an LLM benchmark page with explicit agent instructions. Together these cover every element of pointing an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://developer.paddle.com/llms.txt # Paddle Developer Docs
Agent skills are a standardized way to give AI agents instructions on how to integrate Paddle... written specifically for agents, rather than humans
The Paddle docs MCP server gives AI agents full, current knowledge of Paddle so you can build, integrate, and troubleshoot without relying on stale training data.
